item.title: [ 44] A big reason why old games are more enjoyable than new games is because they we
item.description:
A big reason why old games are more enjoyable than new games is because they were made before the mass adoption of the internet and social media, both of which drastically changed how creators express themselves
>characters just used to be characters, stuff the devs thought was cool
>characters are now obvious popular archetypes and fetishes that devs know get traction online
>game stories and premises were full of unpredictable idiosyncrasies
>stories and premises are now a checklist of popular tropes from TV Tropes and lorebait that gets people to make essays
>mechanics were internal experiments the dev team decided to pursue based on their own ideas
>mechanics are now a grab bag of whatever the best selling games are doing with no regard for how they come together

There's a certain joy in playing a game and not having to think "I know this mechanic from X" or "this character looks like this because Y gets a lot of fanart" every 10 seconds that modern devs will never be able to replicate

item.title: [ 41] Nastiest Food Story Time
item.description:
What is the nastiest food you ever had the displeasure of eating. I'll go first.

>Be me. 7 year old kid obsessed with Transformers, Skeletor, G.I. Joe, Dragons, and GoBots.
>Have friends.
>Stay the night at a friend's house.
>His mom makes hormel, beanless chili-mac (kraft).
>Barely keep from vomiting.
>Asked by his mom if I liked it.
>Politely smile and nod my head.
>She immediately tells my mom over the phone that I loved it and gives her the recipe.

item.title: [110] Any Chance Of Iran Nuclear Deal Likely Dead In The Water
item.description:
U.S. President Donald Trump is “showing patience” as talks with Iran face a new obstacle, with Tehran demanding sweeping concessions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and return to nuclear negotiations, including financial reparations and the withdrawal of American forces from the region, The Wall Street Journal reported Sunday.

U.S. administration officials told the Journal that Trump intends to wait for the current impasse to be resolved. They did not say whether he would accept Iran’s conditions, which also include sanctions relief, but said he would be prepared to lift the U.S. blockade on Iranian ports if Tehran “fully opens” the Strait of Hormuz.

The reopening of Hormuz is supposed to pave the way for renewed negotiations over an agreement restricting Iran’s nuclear program, following the memorandum of understanding reached in June. The White House said at the time that the memorandum was intended to restore freedom of navigation through Hormuz while moving toward a broader nuclear agreement.

But according to the Journal, Trump has privately raised with senior advisers another possibility: ending the U.S. campaign even without a new nuclear deal if Iran fully reopens the strait. Such an outcome would restore a crucial route for global energy supplies and could ease fuel prices for American consumers, an increasingly important political consideration for the president.

item.title: [ 30] It Happened Again
item.description:
https://www.wcnc.com/article/news/local/dilworth-attack-arrest-sparks-safety-concerns-questions-about-suspects-criminal-history/275-366d6dc9-a143-4371-ada4-27e01f816e15

CHARLOTTE, N.C. — The arrest of a man accused of randomly attacking women in Charlotte’s Dilworth neighborhood is bringing a sense of relief to some residents but also raising questions about public safety and how the criminal justice system handles repeat offenders.

Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police arrested 32-year-old Di-Quan Schafar Hunt after investigators say they connected him to an assault captured on camera along East Boulevard and other videos circulating on social media showing women being attacked.

Police say the July 30 assault happened on East Boulevard, where investigators say Hunt approached a woman walking on the sidewalk and punched her in the face with a closed fist.

The victim was taken to a hospital with serious but non-life-threatening injuries.

CMPD says detectives later identified Hunt after reviewing a social media account containing multiple videos they were investigating.

Hunt was taken into custody Aug. 6 after officers responded to an attempt-to-locate call on East Fourth Street. Police say he was taken to a medical facility for treatment and will be transferred to the Mecklenburg County Sheriff’s Office once released, where he will face an assault with a deadly weapon charge.

Some Dilworth residents say they are shaken after the attack. For people who walk, work and spend time along East Boulevard, residents say the randomness of the assault has been difficult to process.

“It’s very disturbing, sickening,” said Bill Godwin, owner of Paper Skyscraper. “It’s terrifying for everyone.”

Godwin says his business was closed at the time of the attack, but he helped investigators identify nearby cameras to help track down the suspect.

item.title: [ 44] Real Traveler's map™ thread
item.description:
Post your travel maps in this thread. Pic related is the official /trv/ Real Traveler's map™, edition 4.0.5. I am remaking this general after almost a year of it being dead, so this is not the usual OP.

Fill in the countries and subdivisions you have visited, talk about your map and ask others about their maps. You can use the map however you like, the colors are more like suggestions, you don't have to use them, and you don't have to use all of them. You can add or remove colors and change the map as much as you want in any way you want. Don't like this map? Upload a completely different one. Up to you. Despite what some might say, there's no "wrong" way to use the map, and new posters and less travelled people are welcome and encouraged to stay and post :) This map is a group effort by our board, and we can only improve it if people reach out to share suggestions or corrections.

This is the newest edition of the map, edition 4.0.5, updated for September 2025. Thanks to an Anon in previous threads, it is now easier than ever to fill in the map. You can use the website splored.com to easily color in entire countries with a single click. At the time of making this thread, it uses the old 4.0.4 template, so you still need to update it to 4.0.5 with the simplified template, but hopefully it will be updated.
